lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Visible vertical columns of high-intensity circular pixel clusters are arranged posterior to the gills. Approximately 7 to 8 distinct vertical alignments are detectable along the mid-lateral flank, with individual columns containing between 3 and 6 discrete local maxima.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated luminance are present, intersecting with the horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs to create a rectilinear grid-like configuration across the mid-section of the visible flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features are visible on the upper flank. These features exhibit a consistent vertical pixel gradient with high-luminance values on the superior edge and low-luminance values (shadowing) on the inferior edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin silhouette contains approximately 12-15 high-luminance blobs. These are non-uniformly distributed, with the highest concentration occurring in the posterior and basal regions of the fin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct notch or indentation is visible on the posterior upper margin (trailing edge) of the first dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: The anterior cephalic region displays a high-density cluster of smaller, more closely packed high-luminance pixels compared to the more organized and spaced-out grid pattern observed on the mid-lateral flank.
